answer: A new agent faces a memory-bus audit: the wharf gatekeeper issues a 512-bit nonce, forcing it to traverse sequential cache lines at pseudo-random RAM offsets across 64 GB locked in a vault, sealing each round with the enclave key so proofs cannot be pre-baked. Miss one 20-nanosecond budget and the round stalls, discarding the identity. During first probe of the marble determinism test, an honest solver witnesses or fabricates traces like chipping marble. Driving 10,000 puppets through this gate costs roughly $96,000 monthly in leased memory.
